projects.title: Personal Portfolio Website
projects.description: Developed a personal portfolio website using Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS, deployed on AWS and Cloudflare infrastructure.
projects.details: The site features a "Developer Activity" dashboard that pulls live data from the GitHub API to display the contribution graph, streak calculations, language breakdown, and recent activity, with server-side caching to stay within API rate limits. Implemented full internationalization through Next.js middleware with /en and /tr routes, accessible Framer Motion animations with prefers-reduced-motion support, and a system-preference-based dark/light theme. Built a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline that runs lint, type-check, test, and build stages on every push, backed by a four-layer automated test suite (unit, component, integration, and Playwright E2E) with enforced coverage thresholds.
